question: Does similarity in late-glacial-to-present climate displacement predict source-target transferability beyond current environmental similarity, geography, lineage, and sampling geometry?

independent_species_domain.reason: C must be species-disjoint from all prior confirmatory design universes and from the entire B fresh-1000, regardless of B feasibility or outcome.
independent_species_domain.scan_rule: After all frozen exclusions, scan source-archive metadata in SHA256('relational-history-candidate-v0.1|<phylogatr_source_sha256>|<species>') order; evaluate the exact frozen geometry eligibility above without nucleotide identity; retain the first 1000 eligible species, or all eligible species if 500-999; fewer than 500 is NOT_EVALUABLE.

geometry_eligibility.taxon: Animalia excluding Aves and Chiroptera, matching the inherited relational candidate firewall
geometry_eligibility.marker: COI-family locus under the frozen aliases in docs/supporting/relational_genetic_protocol_v0.1.json
geometry_eligibility.selection_if_eligible_between_500_and_99: retain all eligible species in frozen hash order; do not lower the minimum or scan a response-dependent replacement universe

external_occurrences.inheritance: Use the same exact-match, 2010-2026, coordinate/geospatial-status, duplicate, deterministic-priority, 10-km thinning, max-200 and min-30 occurrence rules frozen for Study B.

historical_climate.temporal_coverage: 21 ka BP to 0 BP in centennial time steps

auxiliary_descriptive_only.name: glz
auxiliary_descriptive_only.meaning: ice-sheet surface altitude; descriptive only, no confirmatory alpha

historical_climate.model_citation: Karger et al. 2023, Climate of the Past 19:439-456
historical_climate.missing_rule: At a current occurrence coordinate, retain a row only if all four variables are finite at both 21 ka BP and 0 BP; species must retain >=30 rows.

asset_contract.official_download_surface: CHELSA EnviCloud distribution linked by the official dataset page
asset_contract.first_download_freeze: Before any Study-C character mask, nucleotide identity, T_st, or beta_hist is opened, record the exact resolved object URL and SHA256 of all eight required rasters in a response-blind asset receipt.
asset_contract.substitution_rule: No alternate time slice, variable, version, paleoclimate product, or best-performing asset may replace a missing required raster. Missing/unresolvable required assets make slot C NOT_EVALUABLE_EXTERNAL_DATA.
asset_contract.raster_sampling: Require a geographic CRS and sample each frozen current occurrence at its longitude/latitude. Do not interpolate across nodata; a row is retained only when all eight primary raster values are finite.
asset_contract.filename_evidence: Published CHELSA-TraCE21k usage identifies the 0-BP and LGM bio01 assets as CHELSA_TraCE21K_bio01_20_V1.0.tif and CHELSA_TraCE21K_bio01_-190_V1.0.tif; the frozen logical asset set applies the same provider naming convention to bio07, bio12 and bio15.
asset_contract.case_policy: Provider-object lookup may resolve a case-only spelling difference in the literal object key, but variable, time index, version and dataset identity must exactly match the frozen logical asset. The exact resolved URL and SHA256 are frozen on first response-blind download; no alternate scientific asset is allowed.

historical_displacement_relation.per_occurrence_vector: DeltaX = [bio01_21ka-bio01_0, bio07_21ka-bio07_0, bio12_21ka-bio12_0, bio15_21ka-bio15_0] at the frozen current occurrence coordinate.
historical_displacement_relation.pooled_standardization: Pool up to the first 50 retained occurrence rows per species in frozen occurrence-priority order; standardize each Delta variable by pooled mean and population SD.
historical_displacement_relation.pca: Canonical-sign PCA on the pooled standardized Delta vectors; retain PC1-PC2 and whiten by pooled eigenvalues.
historical_displacement_relation.species_density: 50x50 fixed grid with pooled 0.5th-99.5th percentile bounds plus 10% padding; isotropic Gaussian KDE with Scott factor n_species^(-1/6); each density sums to 1.
historical_displacement_relation.primary_relation: R_hist_st = Schoener's D between source and target historical-displacement densities.

current_environment_nuisance.relation: Compute the same current-environment Schoener-D representation as Study B on the C species only.
current_environment_nuisance.role: nuisance control; it cannot replace R_hist or become a second primary test

panel_assignment_after_historical_admiss.confirmatory_response: one-shot only after exact mask and survivor requalification

primary_model.response: T_st, the unchanged source-to-target post-IBD transfer skill
primary_model.inference: two-way source/target cluster-robust one-sided beta_hist test

synthetic_qualification.private_type1_gate: Wilson 95% upper bound of p<=0.025 rejection rate <=0.05 in every frozen private-null cell
synthetic_qualification.positive_power_gate: Wilson 95% lower bound of p<=0.025 rejection rate >=0.80 for beta_hist_latent=0.03
synthetic_qualification.failure: NOT_EVALUABLE_HISTORICAL_SYNTHETIC_QUALIFICATION; slot C is forfeited with no replacement and no alpha reassignment

stopping_and_firewall: Do not inspect or use Study-B qualification or empirical genetic outcomes to change C candidate selection, climate variables, time slices, Delta definition, PCA/KDE settings, controls, estimator, effect floor, alpha, or gates.
Do not substitute ice-sheet/permafrost presence, refugial overlap, barrier crossing, or another historical predictor if this frozen C route fails.
Any external-data, geometry, mask, or synthetic gate failure is NOT_EVALUABLE, not a biological null.
No alternative C slot may be added.
Do not alter the frozen LGM time index -190, 0-BP time index 20, or required eight logical raster-asset set after asset resolution begins.
